title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of a classic ’82 set with Jerry’s soaring licks, a jam‑heavy Terrapin Station and a smoking Scarlet > Fire transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality, though one reviewer notes a slight tape‑speed increase that pushes the mix a bit fast and slightly recesses Phil’s bass. Musically the show shines – Jerry delivers tremendous licks, Terrapin Station stretches into an epic jamfest and the Scarlet > Fire segue is described as “sick,” making it a high‑energy highlight of a classic 1982 performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, highlighting strong musicianship and an excellent clean soundboard, with only minor comments about speed/balance that keep the rating just below perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clean and crisp; reviewers call it “the kind of soundboard you seek.” One note mentions a half‑step fast playback and slight balance issues, but overall the audio is clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic ’82 flow with a jam‑heavy Terrapin that stretches nearly 12 minutes and a seamless, deliberate transition from Scarlet to Fire; overall the set feels tight yet adventurous.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tremendous licks noted; Jerry is “digging it” throughout the performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass sits a bit in the background, likely due to mix and the slightly fast tape speed.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are perfectly matched to the jams, adding subtle texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Subtle yet deliberate drumming highlighted by reviewers.
